words.enDefinition: The layer that transfers data over a single link or local network segment.

examples.en: The link layer handles the first part of the packet's journey across the classroom network.
examples.zh: 「链路层」负责数据包在教室网络中传输的第一段路程。

examples.en: Our diagram shows the link layer directly beneath the network layer in this model.
examples.zh: 在这个模型里，图上把「链路层」画在网络层的正下方。

words.enDefinition: The layer that handles logical addresses and forwards packets between networks.

examples.en: The network layer helps the packet reach a service on a different campus network.
examples.zh: 「网络层」帮助数据包抵达另一个校园网络里的服务。

examples.en: In the worksheet, the network layer chooses a route using the packet's destination address.
examples.zh: 在练习中，「网络层」根据数据包的目的地址选择路由。

words.enDefinition: The layer that provides communication between applications on different endpoints.

examples.en: Our diagram places the transport layer between the application layer and the network layer.
examples.zh: 图中把「传输层」画在应用层和网络层之间。

examples.en: The transport layer can offer different delivery guarantees depending on which protocol is used.
examples.zh: 使用的协议不同，「传输层」所提供的交付保证也会不同。

words.enDefinition: The layer whose protocols define the messages exchanged by applications and network services.

examples.en: The application layer defines how the browser asks the library service for a page.
examples.zh: 「应用层」规定浏览器如何向图书馆服务请求页面。

examples.en: We placed the application layer at the top of the diagram beside the HTTP example.
examples.zh: 我们把「应用层」放在图的顶部，就在 HTTP 示例旁边。

words.enDefinition: A set of networking protocols arranged in layers that work together to exchange data.

examples.en: The network protocol stack diagram traces a catalogue request from the browser to the local link.
examples.zh: 「网络协议栈」示意图一路追踪目录请求从浏览器到本地链路的过程。

examples.en: For the quiz, we labelled the network protocol stack with the protocols shown in class.
examples.zh: 做小测时，我们用课堂上讲过的协议给「网络协议栈」作了标注。

collocations: diagram of a network protocol stack

words.enDefinition: The control information at the beginning of a packet, such as addresses or protocol fields.

examples.en: Our lab handout highlights the destination address in the packet header with a blue box.
examples.zh: 实验讲义用蓝色方框标出了「数据包首部」里的目的地址。

examples.en: The packet header includes information the router needs even when it ignores the carried data.
examples.zh: 就算路由器不查看包内数据，「数据包首部」也含有所需信息。

words.enDefinition: The content carried in a packet apart from that packet's own header.

examples.en: In the diagram, the packet payload starts immediately after the last field of the header.
examples.zh: 图中「数据包有效载荷」紧接在首部最后一个字段之后。

examples.en: The packet payload carries a transport segment in the example on the first page.
examples.zh: 第一页的示例中，「数据包有效载荷」携带的是一个传输层报文段。

words.enDefinition: A structured unit of data used to deliver information over an Ethernet link.

examples.en: We drew an Ethernet frame around the IP packet on the classroom whiteboard today.
examples.zh: 我们今天在教室白板上画出了把 IP 包封装在内的「以太网帧」。

examples.en: In the sample Ethernet frame, the two address fields identify interfaces on the local link.
examples.zh: 在示例「以太网帧」中，两个地址字段用来标识本地链路上的接口。

words.enDefinition: A link-layer identifier used to address a network interface on networks such as Ethernet.

examples.en: The diagram shows a MAC address in the Ethernet header next to the address label.
examples.zh: 示意图把「MAC 地址」标在以太网首部里，就在地址标签旁边。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks which MAC address belongs to the receiving interface on the local link.
examples.zh: 练习题问的是哪个「MAC 地址」属于本地链路上的接收接口。

words.enDefinition: The largest packet size that a particular link can carry without fragmentation at the relevant layer.

examples.en: The slide lists the maximum transmission unit for each link in the illustrated route.
examples.zh: 幻灯片列出了图中路径上每条链路的「最大传输单元」。

examples.en: In the exercise, the maximum transmission unit is given in bytes next to the link.
examples.zh: 练习把「最大传输单元」用字节表示，写在链路旁边。

words.enDefinition: A 32-bit Internet Protocol address commonly written as four decimal numbers separated by dots.

examples.en: The IPv4 address in our worksheet has four decimal numbers separated by three dots.
examples.zh: 练习纸上的「IPv4 地址」由三个点隔开的四个十进制数组成。

examples.en: Mina copied the IPv4 address from the classroom handout into the correct box on her diagram.
examples.zh: 米娜把课堂讲义上的「IPv4 地址」抄到了图中对应的方框里。

words.enDefinition: A 128-bit Internet Protocol address normally written as colon-separated groups of hexadecimal digits.

examples.en: The tutor showed how the same IPv6 address can have a shorter written form.
examples.zh: 老师演示了同一个「IPv6 地址」可以怎样缩写。

examples.en: Our sample IPv6 address uses double colons to shorten a run of zero groups.
examples.zh: 示例「IPv6 地址」用双冒号缩写了连续的全零组。

words.enDefinition: A unit of data sent using the Internet Protocol, containing an IP header and its payload.

examples.en: The IP datagram shown on the slide contains a header followed by the carried data.
examples.zh: 幻灯片上的「IP 数据报」先是首部，后面跟着它承载的数据。

examples.en: The same IP datagram is drawn inside a link layer frame in the second illustration.
examples.zh: 第二张图把同一个「IP 数据报」画在链路层帧里面。

words.enDefinition: The initial bits common to a block of IP addresses.

examples.en: Every address in this practice block starts with the same address prefix on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸上，该地址块中的每个地址都以相同的「地址前缀」开头。

examples.en: The router diagram shows which address prefix matches the destination on the sample packet.
examples.zh: 路由器示意图标出了和示例数据包目的地址相匹配的「地址前缀」。

words.enDefinition: The number of initial bits that make up an IP address prefix.

examples.en: In the worksheet, the prefix length tells us how many leading bits belong to the network prefix.
examples.zh: 在练习中，「前缀长度」说明开头有多少位属于网络前缀。

examples.en: We wrote the prefix length after the slash on each of the sample address blocks.
examples.zh: 我们把「前缀长度」写在每个示例地址块的斜杠后面。

words.enDefinition: A way to write an IP address or block with a slash followed by its prefix length.

examples.en: The first column uses CIDR notation to show the address and prefix length together.
examples.zh: 第一列用「CIDR 表示法」把地址和前缀长度写在一起。

examples.en: Our class uses CIDR notation in diagrams for both the IPv4 and IPv6 examples.
examples.zh: 课堂上的 IPv4 和 IPv6 示例图都使用「CIDR 表示法」。

collocations: represent a block in CIDR notation
express a prefix in CIDR notation

words.enDefinition: An IP address that lets a device send network traffic back to itself.

examples.en: The classroom diagram uses a loopback address for a service running on the same computer.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图用「环回地址」指向同一台电脑上运行的服务。

examples.en: In this lab, a request to the loopback address stays on the student's own machine.
examples.zh: 在这次实验中，发送到「环回地址」的请求始终留在学生自己的电脑上。

words.enDefinition: The router a device uses to reach destinations without a more specific route.

examples.en: The default gateway appears beside the classroom computers in our simple campus network diagram.
examples.zh: 在简化的校园网络图里，「默认网关」画在教室电脑旁。

examples.en: The example laptop sends traffic through its default gateway when no more specific route applies.
examples.zh: 没有更具体的路由时，示例电脑通过「默认网关」发送数据。

words.enDefinition: A set of route entries used to decide where to send packets for particular destinations.

examples.en: The routing table on our worksheet lists three destination prefixes and their corresponding next hops.
examples.zh: 练习纸上的「路由表」列出了三个目的前缀以及各自的下一跳。

examples.en: The tutor added another row to the routing table before discussing the second example.
examples.zh: 老师讲解第二个例子之前，在「路由表」里又加了一行。

words.enDefinition: The next node to receive a packet along its route, often a router.

examples.en: In the diagram, the next hop for this destination is the router outside our lab.
examples.zh: 图中，这个目的地对应的「下一跳」是实验室外的路由器。

examples.en: Two different destination prefixes point to the same next hop in this simplified routing table.
examples.zh: 这张简化路由表里，两个不同的目的前缀指向同一个「下一跳」。

words.enDefinition: The IPv6 header field that limits how many routers can forward a packet.

examples.en: The Hop Limit field in the IPv6 diagram shows a lower value after each forwarding step.
examples.zh: IPv6 图中的「跳数限制字段」在每次转发后都显示更低的数值。

examples.en: The tutor circled the Hop Limit field so we could distinguish it from the payload length.
examples.zh: 老师圈出了「跳数限制字段」，方便我们把它与有效载荷长度区分开。

collocations: zero in the Hop Limit field

words.enDefinition: A name used to identify a host on a network, often within a domain.

examples.en: The host name on our diagram identifies the classroom catalogue server within the example domain.
examples.zh: 图中的「主机名」用来标识示例域里的课堂目录服务器。

examples.en: The sample URL contains the host name before the slash that starts the path.
examples.zh: 示例 URL 的「主机名」位于路径开头的斜杠之前。

words.enDefinition: A complete DNS name that specifies a location in the domain hierarchy all the way to the root.

examples.en: The fully qualified domain name includes all the labels needed to find our example host.
examples.zh: 「完全限定域名」包含定位示例主机所需的所有标签。

examples.en: The DNS exercise contrasts a fully qualified domain name with a short local name.
examples.zh: DNS 练习比较了「完全限定域名」和本地短名称。

collocations: resolve a fully qualified domain name
write a fully qualified domain name
fully qualified domain name ending in a dot

words.enDefinition: The distributed naming system that stores information associated with domain names.

examples.en: The Domain Name System lets software look up information using a name such as example.org.
examples.zh: 「域名系统」让软件能用 example.org 这样的名称查询相关信息。

examples.en: We drew the Domain Name System as a tree to show how its names are arranged.
examples.zh: 我们把「域名系统」画成一棵树，展示名称是怎样分层的。

words.enDefinition: A request to find information associated with a name in the Domain Name System.

examples.en: The lesson starts with a DNS lookup for the address of the example catalogue service.
examples.zh: 这堂课先做一次「DNS 查询」，查找示例目录服务的地址。

examples.en: In our diagram, a DNS lookup happens before the browser sends its first catalogue request.
examples.zh: 图中，浏览器在发送首次目录请求前先做一次「DNS 查询」。

words.enDefinition: A DNS service that answers client queries using its cache or by querying other servers as needed.

examples.en: The recursive resolver already had a valid answer in its cache in the first example.
examples.zh: 第一个例子中，「递归解析器」的缓存里已经有一个有效答案。

examples.en: The arrows show the recursive resolver contacting another name server while the browser waits.
examples.zh: 箭头表示浏览器等待期间，「递归解析器」在联系另一个域名服务器。

collocations: send a query to a recursive resolver

words.enDefinition: A DNS server that serves the official records for a particular zone.

examples.en: The authoritative name server holds the published records for the example zone in our diagram.
examples.zh: 图中的「权威域名服务器」保存着示例域区已发布的记录。

examples.en: We identified the authoritative name server for each zone by reading the labels on the whiteboard.
examples.zh: 我们根据白板上的标签找出了每个域区的「权威域名服务器」。

collocations: authoritative name server for a zone

words.enDefinition: A portion of the DNS namespace managed as a unit by the responsible authority.

examples.en: The DNS zone on our diagram covers the names assigned to the example department.
examples.zh: 图中的「DNS 区」涵盖分配给示例院系的名称。

examples.en: The second team drew a separate DNS zone for the delegated part of the tree.
examples.zh: 第二组为域名树中委托出去的部分画了一个独立的「DNS 区」。

words.enDefinition: An entry in DNS containing a particular type of information for a name.

examples.en: The sample DNS record associates the catalogue name with a classroom example IP address.
examples.zh: 示例「DNS 记录」把目录名称与课堂用的示例 IP 地址关联起来。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to identify the type of each DNS record on the sheet.
examples.zh: 老师让我们辨认练习纸上每条「DNS 记录」的类型。

words.enDefinition: A DNS record that maps a name to an IPv4 address.

examples.en: The A record for the example catalogue contains a single IPv4 address in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，示例目录的「A 记录」包含一个 IPv4 地址。

examples.en: We put the A record in the IPv4 column and the AAAA record in the next column.
examples.zh: 我们把「A 记录」填进 IPv4 那一列，把 AAAA 记录填进后一列。

words.enDefinition: A DNS record that maps a name to an IPv6 address.

examples.en: The AAAA record on the slide contains an IPv6 address written with two consecutive colons.
examples.zh: 幻灯片上的「AAAA 记录」含有一个用双冒号缩写的 IPv6 地址。

examples.en: We looked for the AAAA record when reading the sample answer to the IPv6 query.
examples.zh: 阅读 IPv6 查询的示例答案时，我们找的是「AAAA 记录」。

words.enDefinition: A DNS record that specifies the canonical name associated with an alias.

examples.en: The CNAME record links the short catalogue name to another name in the example zone.
examples.zh: 「CNAME 记录」把简短的目录名称指向示例 DNS 区中的另一个名称。

examples.en: The CNAME record in the diagram points to a host name listed in the next row.
examples.zh: 图中的「CNAME 记录」指向下一行列出的主机名。

words.enDefinition: A value in seconds specifying how long a DNS record may be kept in a cache before it must be refreshed for ordinary reuse.

examples.en: The worksheet gives the DNS record TTL in seconds next to each sample answer.
examples.zh: 练习纸在每个示例答案旁用秒标明了「DNS 记录生存时间」。

examples.en: The resolver can reuse this cached answer while the DNS record TTL has time remaining.
examples.zh: 「DNS 记录生存时间」还有剩余时，解析器可以复用这个缓存答案。

words.enDefinition: The Internet transport protocol that provides applications with a reliable, ordered stream of bytes.

examples.en: The Transmission Control Protocol gives the catalogue application an ordered stream of response bytes.
examples.zh: 「传输控制协议」为目录应用提供有序的响应字节流。

examples.en: Our worksheet compares the Transmission Control Protocol with a protocol that preserves individual messages.
examples.zh: 练习纸把「传输控制协议」和一种保留独立消息的协议作了比较。

words.enDefinition: An Internet transport protocol that carries individual datagrams without guaranteeing delivery or ordering.

examples.en: The User Datagram Protocol carries each practice message as a separate datagram in this simulation.
examples.zh: 这次模拟中，「用户数据报协议」把每条练习消息作为独立的数据报传输。

examples.en: The User Datagram Protocol does not guarantee that the simulated messages arrive in order.
examples.zh: 「用户数据报协议」不保证模拟消息按顺序到达。

words.enDefinition: A transport model in which endpoints establish a connection before exchanging application data.

examples.en: The class used connection-oriented transport to illustrate what happens before a catalogue response begins.
examples.zh: 课堂上用「面向连接的传输」说明目录响应开始前会发生什么。

examples.en: The diagram shows the initial exchange required by connection-oriented transport before the first page request.
examples.zh: 图中标出了首次页面请求前「面向连接的传输」需要进行的初始交换。

words.enDefinition: A transport model in which messages can be sent without establishing a transport connection first.

examples.en: The diagram uses connectionless transport for the example with separate updates from a classroom sensor.
examples.zh: 图中，教室传感器逐条发送更新的示例采用「无连接传输」。

examples.en: In this simulation, each message sent by connectionless transport is handled as an independent datagram.
examples.zh: 在这次模拟里，通过「无连接传输」发送的每条消息都作为独立数据报处理。

words.enDefinition: A unit sent by TCP that includes a TCP header and may also carry stream bytes.

examples.en: One TCP segment in the classroom diagram carries the first part of the catalogue response.
examples.zh: 课堂图中的一个「TCP 报文段」承载目录响应的第一部分。

examples.en: We compared a TCP segment carrying data with one containing only control information in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较了承载数据的「TCP 报文段」和只含控制信息的报文段。

words.enDefinition: A message sent using UDP that includes a UDP header and the application's payload.

examples.en: A single UDP datagram carries each temperature reading in the simulated classroom sensor example.
examples.zh: 在教室传感器的模拟示例中，每次温度读数都由一个「UDP 数据报」承载。

examples.en: The worksheet marks the boundary of each UDP datagram with a separate coloured box.
examples.zh: 练习纸用单独的彩色方框标明每个「UDP 数据报」的边界。

words.enDefinition: A numbered identifier that helps a transport protocol direct traffic to the appropriate application endpoint.

examples.en: The transport port in the diagram helps direct the request to the catalogue application.
examples.zh: 图中的「传输层端口」帮助把请求交给目录应用。

examples.en: We labelled the transport port beside the interface address in our classroom networking diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂网络图中，我们在接口地址旁标出了「传输层端口」。

words.enDefinition: The transport header field identifying the port at the sending endpoint.

examples.en: The source port on the sample request belongs to the browser side of the exchange.
examples.zh: 示例请求的「源端口」属于这次交换中的浏览器一端。

examples.en: For the reply, the worksheet places the browser's source port in the destination field.
examples.zh: 在应答示例里，练习纸把浏览器的「源端口」填入目的端口字段。

words.enDefinition: The transport header field identifying the port at the receiving endpoint.

examples.en: The destination port in our request diagram identifies where the catalogue application receives the traffic.
examples.zh: 请求图中的「目的端口」标识目录应用接收数据的位置。

examples.en: In the sample reply, the browser's port appears as the destination port on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在练习纸上的示例应答中，浏览器端口成了「目的端口」。

words.enDefinition: The process through which endpoints create the state needed for a transport connection.

examples.en: The connection establishment phase happens before the catalogue request in our simplified TCP diagram.
examples.zh: 在简化的 TCP 图中，「连接建立」阶段发生在目录请求之前。

examples.en: The worksheet sets aside one row for connection establishment and another for the first request.
examples.zh: 练习纸用一行表示「连接建立」，另一行表示首次请求。

words.enDefinition: The usual three-message exchange that establishes a TCP connection and synchronizes initial sequence numbers.

examples.en: We numbered the arrows of the TCP handshake on the worksheet before discussing the data transfer.
examples.zh: 我们讨论数据传输前，先给练习纸上「TCP 握手」的箭头编号。

examples.en: The TCP handshake appears above the first catalogue request in the protocol sequence diagram.
examples.zh: 在协议时序图中，「TCP 握手」画在首次目录请求的上方。

words.enDefinition: A TCP header value that identifies a position in the numbered stream of bytes.

examples.en: The TCP sequence number in this example marks the first byte carried by the segment.
examples.zh: 例子中的「TCP 序列号」标识该报文段携带的第一个字节。

examples.en: The worksheet asks how the TCP sequence number changes after the next block of data.
examples.zh: 练习题问的是传输下一块数据后，「TCP 序列号」会如何变化。

words.enDefinition: a TCP header field containing the next sequence number expected by the endpoint sending the acknowledgment, when that field is valid

examples.en: The TCP acknowledgment number on the slide identifies the next byte expected by the receiver.
examples.zh: 幻灯片中的「TCP 确认号」标识接收方期待的下一个字节。

examples.en: We compared the TCP acknowledgment number with the sequence numbers marked in the earlier diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「TCP 确认号」与前一张图中标出的序列号作了比较。

words.enDefinition: sending a segment or other data again because its prior transmission may not have been received

examples.en: The simulator shows a retransmission after the sender decides that the earlier segment was lost.
examples.zh: 发送方判断先前的报文段丢失后，模拟器显示了一次「重传」。

examples.en: A dotted arrow marks the retransmission of the missing segment in our classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图用虚线箭头标出丢失报文段的「重传」。

words.enDefinition: The arrival of transport units in a different sequence from the one in which they were sent.

examples.en: The simulator shows out-of-order arrival when the later segment reaches the receiver ahead of the earlier one.
examples.zh: 后发的报文段比先发的先到接收方时，模拟器显示了「乱序到达」。

examples.en: The class discussed why out-of-order arrival of TCP segments need not change the application's byte order.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论了为什么 TCP 报文段「乱序到达」未必改变应用收到的字节顺序。

words.enDefinition: A continuous sequence of bytes presented to an application without built-in message divisions.

examples.en: The catalogue application reads a byte stream even when TCP sends the response in several segments.
examples.zh: 即使 TCP 用多个报文段传输响应，目录应用读到的也是一条「字节流」。

examples.en: Our diagram displays the byte stream as one continuous row rather than separate boxes.
examples.zh: 图中将「字节流」画成连续的一排，没有用方框分隔。

words.enDefinition: The point that separates one complete message from the next.

examples.en: The UDP illustration has a clear message boundary around each reading from the classroom sensor.
examples.zh: 在 UDP 示意图中，教室传感器每次读数都有明确的「消息边界」。

examples.en: The application uses its own format to find the message boundary within the TCP stream.
examples.zh: 应用通过自身规定的格式在 TCP 字节流里找到「消息边界」。

words.enDefinition: A mechanism that limits a sender so it does not overwhelm the receiver's capacity.

examples.en: In the simulation, flow control slows the sender when the receiving application reads data slowly.
examples.zh: 模拟中，接收应用读取数据较慢时，「流量控制」会让发送方放慢速度。

examples.en: Our tutor explained flow control using two computers that can process data at different rates.
examples.zh: 老师用两台处理数据速度不同的电脑讲解「流量控制」。

words.enDefinition: A mechanism that adapts the amount of traffic sent to the conditions on the network path.

examples.en: The networking lab uses congestion control to illustrate how senders respond to a busy path.
examples.zh: 网络实验用「拥塞控制」说明发送方如何应对繁忙的路径。

examples.en: In the simulation, congestion control reduces the sending rate when the shared link becomes overloaded.
examples.zh: 在模拟中，共享链路超负荷时，「拥塞控制」会降低发送速率。

words.enDefinition: The span of bytes a TCP receiver advertises it is prepared to accept, starting at its next expected byte.

examples.en: The receive window shrinks when the receiving program temporarily stops reading in the experiment.
examples.zh: 实验中，接收程序暂时停止读取时，「接收窗口」缩小了。

examples.en: The instructor explained how the sender uses the advertised receive window to limit outstanding data.
examples.zh: 老师讲解了发送方如何利用通告的「接收窗口」限制尚未确认的数据量。

words.enDefinition: The elapsed time for a signal or message to go to an endpoint and for a reply to return.

examples.en: The plotted round-trip time includes both the outgoing journey and the return of the reply.
examples.zh: 图上标出的「往返时间」包括发出信号和收到应答的两个过程。

examples.en: We compared the round-trip time of two example routes using the timing chart in our lecture.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂上的时序图比较了两条示例路径的「往返时间」。

words.enDefinition: The elapsed time for data to travel from the sender to the receiver in one direction.

examples.en: The graph shows one-way delay from the example sender to the receiver without the return leg.
examples.zh: 图表显示示例数据从发送方到接收方的「单向时延」，省去了返回过程。

examples.en: The class recorded one-way delay separately for each direction because the two paths were different.
examples.zh: 由于两个方向使用的路径不同，全班分别记录了各自的「单向时延」。

words.enDefinition: The time a signal takes to travel across the distance between two points on a link.

examples.en: The longer link has a higher propagation delay because the signal has farther to travel.
examples.zh: 信号要走更远的距离，因此较长链路的「传播时延」更高。

examples.en: Our diagram labels propagation delay separately from the time needed to send every bit.
examples.zh: 图中分别标出「传播时延」以及发送所有比特所需的时间。

words.enDefinition: The time required to put all the bits of a packet onto a link.

examples.en: The transmission delay grows when the packet contains more bits at the same link rate.
examples.zh: 在链路速率相同的情况下，数据包包含更多比特时，「传输时延」随之增加。

examples.en: We calculated the transmission delay using the packet length and the link rate on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用练习纸上的包长度和链路速率计算了「传输时延」。

words.enDefinition: The time a packet spends waiting before it can be processed or sent onward.

examples.en: The worksheet shows queuing delay increasing as more packets wait for the same outgoing link.
examples.zh: 练习纸显示，等待使用同一条出链路的数据包越多，「排队时延」越长。

examples.en: At the quietest point in the simulation, the packets experienced almost no queuing delay.
examples.zh: 在模拟中最空闲的时候，数据包几乎没有经历「排队时延」。

words.enDefinition: A connection kept open so that multiple exchanges can take place without opening a new one each time.

examples.en: The browser uses a persistent connection to request the next page in our classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，浏览器使用「持久连接」请求下一页。

examples.en: The tutor drew one persistent connection beneath several requests for catalogue pages and stylesheets.
examples.zh: 老师在几条目录页面和样式表请求的下方画出一条「持久连接」。

words.enDefinition: The sharing of a single connection by several independent logical streams.

examples.en: The HTTP/2 diagram uses stream multiplexing to carry a page and its stylesheet concurrently.
examples.zh: HTTP/2 示意图用「流多路复用」同时传输一个页面和它的样式表。

examples.en: We coloured each pair of request and response messages separately to show stream multiplexing in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上我们用不同颜色标注各组请求和响应，以展示「流多路复用」。

words.enDefinition: The interval after which a transport sender may resend data that has not been acknowledged.

examples.en: The diagram shows the retransmission timeout expiring before the missing segment is sent again.
examples.zh: 图中「重传超时」期限先到，丢失的报文段随后重新发出。

examples.en: Our exercise compares the retransmission timeout with the estimated round-trip time for the sample connection.
examples.zh: 练习把示例连接的「重传超时」时长与估算的往返时间作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The application-level protocol that defines how clients and servers exchange messages for web resources.

examples.en: The Hypertext Transfer Protocol defines the messages our browser and the classroom catalogue server exchange.
examples.zh: 「超文本传输协议」规定浏览器与课堂目录服务器交换的消息。

examples.en: We used the Hypertext Transfer Protocol to explain how the browser requests a public stylesheet.
examples.zh: 我们用「超文本传输协议」来解释浏览器怎样请求一个公开的样式表。

words.enDefinition: A program that sends HTTP requests to a server and receives responses.

examples.en: The browser acts as the HTTP client in our diagram of a catalogue lookup.
examples.zh: 在目录查询示意图中，浏览器充当「HTTP 客户端」。

examples.en: The instructor drew the HTTP client on the left and the catalogue server on the right.
examples.zh: 老师把「HTTP 客户端」画在左边，把目录服务器画在右边。

collocations: an HTTP client sends a request

words.enDefinition: The server capable of providing the authoritative response for a particular resource.

examples.en: The origin server provides the original catalogue response in the classroom diagram of cached copies.
examples.zh: 在课堂的缓存副本示意图中，「源服务器」提供最初的目录响应。

examples.en: In this example, the origin server supplies the new stylesheet after the design team changes it.
examples.zh: 在这个例子里，设计组改了样式表后，由「源服务器」提供新版。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP message that asks a server to perform an operation on a target resource.

examples.en: Our browser sends an HTTP request when we choose the catalogue link in the lesson.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上选中目录链接时，浏览器发出一条「HTTP 请求」。

examples.en: The sample HTTP request asks for a description of the workshop's opening hours in plain text.
examples.zh: 示例「HTTP 请求」以纯文本格式索取工作坊开放时间说明。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP message a server sends as its reply to a request.

examples.en: The HTTP response contains the library opening hours in the format requested by the classroom browser.
examples.zh: 「HTTP 响应」以课堂浏览器请求的格式提供图书馆开放时间。

examples.en: In the sample HTTP response, the status code appeared on the line before the header fields.
examples.zh: 在示例「HTTP 响应」中，状态码位于首部字段之前的状态行上。

words.enDefinition: The part of an HTTP request that specifies what action the client asks the server to perform.

examples.en: The request method is GET when the browser simply retrieves the sample library timetable.
examples.zh: 浏览器仅获取示例图书馆时间表时，「请求方法」是 GET。

examples.en: In the lesson, we checked the request method before reading the body of the message.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先看「请求方法」，再读消息内容。

words.enDefinition: The part of an HTTP request that identifies the resource or other target of the operation.

examples.en: The request target in the diagram identifies the catalogue listing that the browser wants to retrieve.
examples.zh: 图中的「请求目标」标识浏览器想获取的目录列表。

examples.en: Our example uses the same request target for GET and HEAD when referring to one page.
examples.zh: 对于同一页面，示例里的 GET 和 HEAD 使用相同的「请求目标」。

collocations: a request target containing a query

words.enDefinition: A named field in an HTTP request that carries additional information about the message or client preferences.

examples.en: A request header tells the example server which media types the classroom browser can accept.
examples.zh: 一个「请求首部字段」告诉示例服务器课堂浏览器可以接受哪些媒体类型。

examples.en: On the worksheet, we highlighted the request header that lists the browser's preferred language.
examples.zh: 我们在练习纸上标出了列出浏览器首选语言的「请求首部字段」。

words.enDefinition: A named field in an HTTP response that carries metadata about the message or its content.

examples.en: The response header identifies the media type of the illustrated timetable returned by the server.
examples.zh: 「响应首部字段」标明服务器返回的图文时间表所用的媒体类型。

examples.en: The class added a response header to specify how long the sample page stays fresh.
examples.zh: 全班增加了一个「响应首部字段」，说明示例页面在多长时间内保持新鲜。

words.enDefinition: The content carried by an HTTP request apart from its control information and headers.

examples.en: The practice form sends the fictional book title in the request body for the catalogue exercise.
examples.zh: 练习表单把虚构书名放进「请求体」，发送给目录练习服务。

examples.en: The instructor showed where the request body begins beneath the headers in the printed example.
examples.zh: 老师在印发的示例上指出了首部下方「请求体」的起始位置。

words.enDefinition: The content carried by an HTTP response apart from the status information and headers.

examples.en: The browser displays the sample timetable using the HTML supplied in the response body.
examples.zh: 浏览器用「响应体」提供的 HTML 显示示例时间表。

examples.en: The response body in the exercise contains the two opening times shown on the catalogue page.
examples.zh: 练习中的「响应体」包含目录页上显示的两个开放时间。

words.enDefinition: A three-digit number that indicates the outcome of an HTTP request.

examples.en: The HTTP status code tells the classroom browser whether the request for the catalogue succeeded.
examples.zh: 「HTTP 状态码」告诉课堂浏览器，目录请求是否成功。

examples.en: I copied the HTTP status code into the notes column before reading the returned page.
examples.zh: 我在阅读返回的页面前，先把「HTTP 状态码」抄进笔记栏。

words.enDefinition: A category of HTTP responses indicated by the first digit of the status code.

examples.en: The tutor asked which status code class includes the response for a missing catalogue page.
examples.zh: 老师问目录页面不存在时，服务器返回的响应属于哪个「状态码类别」。

examples.en: We recorded the status code class for each response before discussing the individual codes.
examples.zh: 我们讨论各个状态码之前，先记录了每种响应的「状态码类别」。

collocations: group responses by status code class

words.enDefinition: An HTTP request using GET to retrieve a representation of its target resource.

examples.en: The browser sends a GET request to retrieve the reading list for the classroom display.
examples.zh: 浏览器发出「GET 请求」，获取教室屏幕要显示的阅读书单。

examples.en: The worksheet follows a GET request from the browser to the example campus catalogue server.
examples.zh: 练习纸展示一条「GET 请求」如何从浏览器到达示例校园目录服务器。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP request that asks for metadata much like a GET request, without response content.

examples.en: The sample HEAD request returns information about the catalogue page without including its HTML content.
examples.zh: 示例「HEAD 请求」返回目录页的相关信息，省去 HTML 内容。

examples.en: Our diagram gives the HEAD request its own row to highlight the absent response body.
examples.zh: 图中用单独一行画出「HEAD 请求」，突出这个响应没有响应体。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP request asking the server to process the supplied content according to the target resource's own rules.

examples.en: The teaching form sends a POST request with a fictional reading suggestion for the class catalogue.
examples.zh: 教学表单用「POST 请求」向课堂用的目录提交一条虚构的阅读推荐。

examples.en: We marked the POST request on the diagram to show which exchange processes the form data.
examples.zh: 我们在图上标出「POST 请求」，说明是哪一次交互在处理表单数据。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP method whose defined purpose is read-only from the client's point of view.

examples.en: For the quiz, we classified GET as a safe method because it requests a page.
examples.zh: 小测里我们把 GET 归为「安全方法」，因为它在这里请求读取页面。

examples.en: The tutor noted that the server could still log requests that use a safe method.
examples.zh: 老师指出，服务器仍然可以记录采用「安全方法」的请求。

collocations: classify GET as a safe method

words.enDefinition: An HTTP method whose intended server-side effect is the same for one request or several identical requests.

examples.en: The tutor used GET as an example of an idempotent method in the catalogue exercise.
examples.zh: 老师在目录练习中用 GET 作为「幂等方法」的例子。

examples.en: With an idempotent method, repeating an identical request has the same intended effect on the server.
examples.zh: 使用「幂等方法」时，重复发送相同请求对服务器的预期效果相同。

words.enDefinition: A standardized label identifying the format of content in a message or resource.

examples.en: The server labels the sample timetable with a media type that identifies it as HTML.
examples.zh: 服务器用「媒体类型」给示例时间表加标签，表明其格式是 HTML。

examples.en: We checked the media type before reading the example response as a plain text file.
examples.zh: 我们查看「媒体类型」后，才把示例响应作为纯文本文件来读。

words.enDefinition: The field that identifies the media type of the content in an HTTP message.

examples.en: The Content-Type header identifies the sample catalogue response as HTML before the browser displays it.
examples.zh: 浏览器显示示例目录前，「Content-Type 首部字段」先标明响应格式为 HTML。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks what format the Content-Type header identifies in the response for the library map.
examples.zh: 练习题问的是图书馆地图响应的「Content-Type 首部字段」标明了哪种格式。

words.enDefinition: The HTTP request field that indicates which media types the client can accept in the response.

examples.en: The Accept header in the example lists the media types preferred by the classroom browser.
examples.zh: 示例里的「Accept 首部字段」列出课堂浏览器偏好的媒体类型。

examples.en: We compared the Accept header with the media type the catalogue server actually returned.
examples.zh: 我们把「Accept 首部字段」和目录服务器实际返回的媒体类型作了比较。

collocations: list media types in the Accept header

words.enDefinition: The field that identifies codings such as compression applied to an HTTP representation.

examples.en: The sample Content-Encoding header shows that the catalogue response was compressed before being sent.
examples.zh: 示例「Content-Encoding 首部字段」表明目录响应在发送前经过压缩。

examples.en: The tutor compared the Content-Encoding header with the field that describes the original media type.
examples.zh: 老师比较了「Content-Encoding 首部字段」和用来描述原始媒体类型的字段。

collocations: detect compression from the Content-Encoding header

words.enDefinition: The selection of a representation for an HTTP resource based on available variants and client preferences.

examples.en: The catalogue service uses content negotiation to choose between an HTML version and a plain text version.
examples.zh: 目录服务利用「内容协商」在 HTML 版和纯文本版之间选择。

examples.en: We illustrated content negotiation by requesting the same classroom notice in two different languages.
examples.zh: 我们用两种语言请求同一则课堂通知，以演示「内容协商」。

words.enDefinition: Data and associated metadata that express the state of a resource in a particular form.

examples.en: The HTML version of the timetable is one resource representation offered by the example server.
examples.zh: HTML 版时间表是示例服务器提供的一种「资源表示」。

examples.en: In the lesson, the browser receives a resource representation suitable for display as a formatted page.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中，浏览器收到一种适合显示为格式化页面的「资源表示」。

words.enDefinition: an HTTP response instructing the client to take a further action such as requesting a different resource

examples.en: An HTTP redirect takes the classroom browser from the former catalogue page to the new one.
examples.zh: 一条「HTTP 重定向」把课堂浏览器从旧的目录移到新页面。

examples.en: The tutor pointed out the HTTP redirect before showing the response from the final page.
examples.zh: 老师在展示最终页面的响应前，先指出了「HTTP 重定向」。

words.enDefinition: The HTTP response field that identifies a URL associated with the response, such as a redirect target.

examples.en: The Location header points to the new catalogue URL in our example of a redirect.
examples.zh: 在重定向示例中，「Location 首部字段」指向目录的新 URL。

examples.en: Our exercise reads the Location header in a response that identifies a newly created resource.
examples.zh: 练习要求读取一条响应的「Location 首部字段」，它标识一个新创建的资源。

collocations: resolve a URL from the Location header

words.enDefinition: The query part of a URL, often used to carry parameters to a web application.

examples.en: The query string in our example holds the selected subject and year for the catalogue search.
examples.zh: 示例中的「查询字符串」保存了目录搜索选定的主题和年份。

examples.en: We changed the query string on paper while keeping the path of the sample URL unchanged.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上修改了「查询字符串」，同时保持示例 URL 的路径不变。

words.enDefinition: A named item in a URL's query component, commonly used as input to a web application.

examples.en: The year query parameter filters the catalogue exercise to books published in the chosen year.
examples.zh: 名为 year 的「查询参数」将目录练习的结果限定为所选年份出版的书。

examples.en: Our worksheet gives each query parameter its own column to distinguish the name from the value.
examples.zh: 练习纸为每个「查询参数」单独设一列，以区分参数的名称和值。

words.enDefinition: The edition of HTTP whose message format and connection rules govern an exchange.

examples.en: The classroom browser shows the HTTP version used to fetch the catalogue page in the example.
examples.zh: 课堂浏览器会显示示例中获取目录页面时用的「HTTP 版本」。

examples.en: Our lesson compares how each HTTP version carries the same request and its matching response.
examples.zh: 这一课比较各个「HTTP 版本」如何传输同一请求及其对应响应。

words.enDefinition: The HTTP version whose textual message format begins with a request or status line.

examples.en: The HTTP/1.1 example shows each header field on a separate line in the printed response.
examples.zh: 「HTTP/1.1」示例把打印响应中的每个首部字段单独列一行。

examples.en: Our diagram shows several requests using the same persistent HTTP/1.1 connection to the catalogue server.
examples.zh: 图中几条请求通过同一条持久的「HTTP/1.1」连接发送到目录服务器。

words.enDefinition: The HTTP version that uses binary frames and supports concurrent streams over one connection.

examples.en: The HTTP/2 diagram shows the catalogue page and stylesheet travelling on different streams of one connection.
examples.zh: 「HTTP/2」示意图显示目录页面和样式表通过同一连接的不同流传输。

examples.en: In class we compared the structure of an HTTP/2 frame with an older HTTP message format.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较了一个「HTTP/2」帧的结构和较早的 HTTP 消息格式。

words.enDefinition: The opening line of an HTTP/1.1 request, containing the method, request target, and protocol version.

examples.en: The request line at the top of the handout shows a GET for the library timetable.
examples.zh: 讲义顶部的「请求行」显示一条获取图书馆时间表的 GET 请求。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to underline the request target found on the request line.
examples.zh: 老师让我们给「请求行」里的请求目标画下划线。

words.enDefinition: The opening line of an HTTP/1.1 response, containing the protocol version and status code.

examples.en: The status line in this HTTP/1.1 example gives the protocol version and the three-digit code.
examples.zh: 这个 HTTP/1.1 示例的「状态行」给出了协议版本和三位数的状态码。

examples.en: We copied the status line first and then looked at the response headers below it.
examples.zh: 我们先抄下「状态行」，然后看下面的响应首部字段。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP status indicating that the server successfully handled the request.

examples.en: The browser displays 200 OK after it retrieves the requested reading list in our demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示中，浏览器获取所请求的阅读书单后显示「200 请求成功」。

examples.en: In the worksheet, 200 OK is the expected response for an existing catalogue page.
examples.zh: 练习纸上，查询已存在的目录页面时，预期响应为「200 请求成功」。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP status indicating that a request succeeded and the response carries no content.

examples.en: The worksheet uses 204 No Content for a successful response that contains no message body.
examples.zh: 练习纸用「204 无内容」表示请求成功但响应没有消息体。

examples.en: We compared 204 No Content with a success response that included an updated reading list.
examples.zh: 我们把「204 无内容」与含有更新后阅读书单的成功响应作了比较。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP status indicating that the server did not find a current representation of the requested resource or would not disclose it.

examples.en: The sample server returns 404 Not Found when the class requests a catalogue page that does not exist.
examples.zh: 全班请求一个不存在的目录页面时，示例服务器返回「404 未找到」。

examples.en: We recorded 404 Not Found beside the old catalogue path in the class worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习纸的旧目录路径旁记下了「404 未找到」。

words.enDefinition: A stored item in an HTTP cache containing a response and details needed to reuse it.

examples.en: The cache entry stores the sample directory response together with the details used for later requests.
examples.zh: 「缓存条目」保存示例目录的响应及后续请求会用到的信息。

examples.en: We looked at one cache entry for the reading list and another for its stylesheet.
examples.zh: 我们查看了阅读书单的一个「缓存条目」以及样式表的另一个条目。

words.enDefinition: a request for which a cache finds a stored result that can be reused for the request

examples.en: The simulation marked a cache hit when a fresh matching stylesheet could be served from memory.
examples.zh: 模拟程序发现内存中有可复用的匹配样式表且仍在有效期内时，标记一次「缓存命中」。

examples.en: In the exercise, a cache hit lets the browser reuse a fresh copy of the timetable.
examples.zh: 练习中，「缓存命中」让浏览器得以复用仍然新鲜的时间表副本。

words.enDefinition: An occasion when a cache has no matching stored result for a request.

examples.en: The first request produces a cache miss because the sample stylesheet has not been stored yet.
examples.zh: 首次请求发生「缓存未命中」，因为示例样式表尚未存入缓存。

examples.en: A cache miss is marked in the chart before the browser receives the new timetable.
examples.zh: 浏览器收到新版时间表之前，图表上标出一次「缓存未命中」。

words.enDefinition: The information a cache uses to match an incoming request with a stored response.

examples.en: Our example uses the request method and target URL as parts of the cache key.
examples.zh: 示例把请求方法和目标 URL 用作「缓存键」的组成部分。

examples.en: The tutor drew the cache key beside each stored response in the simplified catalogue example.
examples.zh: 老师在简化的目录示例中，把「缓存键」画在各个已存响应旁。

words.enDefinition: The period during which a stored HTTP response can qualify as fresh.

examples.en: The sample response's freshness lifetime is long enough for several page views during the class.
examples.zh: 示例响应的「缓存新鲜度有效期」够长，能覆盖课堂上的几次页面浏览。

examples.en: We wrote the freshness lifetime on the diagram beside the age of the stored stylesheet.
examples.zh: 我们在图中把「缓存新鲜度有效期」标在缓存样式表当前的响应年龄旁边。

words.zhGloss: 仍在有效期内的缓存响应
words.enDefinition: A stored HTTP response whose age has not yet reached its freshness lifetime.
acceptedZhAnswers: 仍在有效期内的缓存响应

examples.en: A fresh response in the demonstration can be reused while the class revisits the catalogue page.
examples.zh: 全班重新访问目录页时，演示中的「仍在有效期内的缓存响应」仍可复用。

examples.en: The worksheet labels the saved timetable as a fresh response on the first revisit.
examples.zh: 首次回访时，练习纸将已保存的时间表标记为「仍在有效期内的缓存响应」。

collocations: a fresh response in the cache

words.zhGloss: 已过有效期的缓存响应
words.enDefinition: A stored HTTP response whose age has reached or exceeded its freshness lifetime.
acceptedZhAnswers: 已过有效期的缓存响应

examples.en: The diagram marks a stale response once the stored timetable reaches the end of its freshness lifetime.
examples.zh: 缓存的时间表到了新鲜期末尾，示意图便把它标为「已过有效期的缓存响应」。

examples.en: In the second example, the browser checks whether the stale response still matches the current page.
examples.zh: 第二个示例中，浏览器检查「已过有效期的缓存响应」是否仍与当前页面一致。

words.enDefinition: A check to determine whether a stored HTTP response is still valid for reuse.

examples.en: The browser performs cache revalidation for the saved stylesheet before reusing it in the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示中，浏览器先对保存的样式表执行「缓存重新验证」，然后才复用它。

examples.en: Cache revalidation saved the classroom browser from downloading the entire unchanged timetable again in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，「缓存重新验证」让课堂浏览器省去了重新下载整份未修改的时间表。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP request with fields that make its outcome depend on a test of resource metadata.

examples.en: The browser uses a conditional request to check whether the cached catalogue page has changed.
examples.zh: 浏览器用「条件请求」检查缓存的目录页是否有变化。

examples.en: The tutor showed which field made our conditional request depend on the saved entity tag.
examples.zh: 老师指出是哪个字段让「条件请求」的结果取决于已保存的实体标签。

words.enDefinition: Metadata used to check whether a cached representation can still be reused.

examples.en: The sample entity tag serves as a cache validator for the stylesheet in our exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习里，示例实体标签充当样式表的「缓存验证器」。

examples.en: The diagram stores a cache validator beside each copy of the timetable for later checks.
examples.zh: 示意图在每份时间表副本旁存放一个「缓存验证器」，供之后检查时使用。

words.enDefinition: An opaque value supplied by a server to identify a particular representation for comparison.

examples.en: The server assigns an entity tag to the example stylesheet so the browser can check it later.
examples.zh: 服务器给示例样式表分配一个「实体标签」，便于浏览器之后检查。

examples.en: The entity tag in our worksheet differs between the two versions of the same timetable.
examples.zh: 练习中的同一份时间表有两个版本，「实体标签」不同。

words.enDefinition: The HTTP field reporting when the origin server believes the selected representation last changed.

examples.en: The Last-Modified header shows when the example timetable was last updated on the catalogue server.
examples.zh: 「Last-Modified 首部字段」显示示例时间表上次在目录服务器上更新的时间。

examples.en: Our worksheet compares the Last-Modified header with the time the response was originally sent.
examples.zh: 练习纸把「Last-Modified 首部字段」与响应最初发出的时间作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The HTTP status telling a client that a conditional GET or HEAD can use its stored representation.

examples.en: The example server returns 304 Not Modified when the saved timetable is still the current version.
examples.zh: 已保存的时间表仍是当前版本时，示例服务器返回「304 未修改」。

examples.en: In our diagram, 304 Not Modified allows the browser to reuse the existing stylesheet.
examples.zh: 图中，「304 未修改」让浏览器得以复用已有样式表。

words.enDefinition: The field that carries directives about caching and reuse in HTTP messages.

examples.en: The Cache-Control header states how long the example response may be considered fresh by the cache.
examples.zh: 「Cache-Control 首部字段」说明缓存可以在多长时间内把示例响应视为新鲜。

examples.en: We found the Cache-Control header in the printed response for the classroom timetable today.
examples.zh: 今天我们在课堂时间表的打印响应中找到了「Cache-Control 首部字段」。

words.enDefinition: An HTTP caching directive stating an age limit, used in responses to specify a freshness lifetime.

examples.en: The max-age directive in our response example sets the freshness lifetime of the saved timetable.
examples.zh: 响应示例中的「max-age 指令」设定了时间表的缓存新鲜度有效期。

examples.en: The tutor pointed out that the value of the max-age directive is expressed in seconds.
examples.zh: 老师指出，「max-age 指令」的值以秒为单位。

words.enDefinition: A document whose markup describes the structure and content of a web page or related resource.

examples.en: The HTML document for the classroom catalogue contains a heading and a short list of books.
examples.zh: 课堂目录的「HTML 文档」包含一个标题和一份简短的图书清单。

examples.en: We opened the tiny HTML document in a browser to see the reading list it describes.
examples.zh: 我们用浏览器打开简短的「HTML 文档」，查看它描述的阅读书单。

words.enDefinition: A structural component of an HTML document, often represented in markup by one or more tags.

examples.en: The class added an HTML element to turn the title into a heading on the page.
examples.zh: 全班添加了一个「HTML 元素」，让书单标题成为页面上的标题。

examples.en: In our tree diagram, each HTML element for a book title sits inside the list.
examples.zh: 树状图里，用于书名的每个「HTML 元素」都在列表之内。

words.enDefinition: A name or name-value setting in HTML markup that gives additional information about an element.

examples.en: An HTML attribute supplies the alternative text for the picture in our classroom timetable example.
examples.zh: 课堂时间表示例通过「HTML 属性」为图片提供替代文本。

examples.en: The tutor underlined the HTML attribute that points to the stylesheet for the catalogue page.
examples.zh: 老师在指向目录页样式表的「HTML 属性」下面画了线。

words.enDefinition: The software component that reads HTML markup and builds the document structure from it.

examples.en: The HTML parser reads the classroom catalogue file and builds a tree from its markup.
examples.zh: 「HTML 解析器」读取课堂目录文件，按其标记构建一棵树。

examples.en: Our diagram shows the HTML parser creating a list element before adding its first item.
examples.zh: 图中，「HTML 解析器」先创建列表元素，再加入第一项。

words.enDefinition: The model that represents a document as objects in a tree and defines ways to work with them.

examples.en: The Document Object Model lets the class describe the catalogue as a tree of related nodes.
examples.zh: 「文档对象模型」让全班可以把目录描述为由相互关联的节点组成的树。

examples.en: We traced the Document Object Model from the list element to its first item.
examples.zh: 我们顺着「文档对象模型」，从列表元素找到它的第一项。

words.enDefinition: An object in a DOM tree, such as an element node, a text node, or the document itself.

examples.en: The tree diagram shows a DOM node for the text inside the example heading.
examples.zh: 树状图用一个「DOM 节点」表示示例标题里的文字。

examples.en: We followed the links from one DOM node to its parent in the catalogue exercise.
examples.zh: 在目录练习中，我们沿着节点关系，从一个「DOM 节点」找到它的父节点。

words.enDefinition: A collection of rules that describe how a web document or other structured content should be presented.

examples.en: The stylesheet gives headings and book titles different colours on the example catalogue page.
examples.zh: 「样式表」让示例目录页里的标题和书名用不同颜色显示。

examples.en: Our class moved the colour rules into a separate stylesheet shared by the two sample pages.
examples.zh: 我们班把颜色规则移到独立的「样式表」中，让两个示例页面共用。

words.enDefinition: A pattern in a style rule that identifies the elements to which the rule can apply.

examples.en: The CSS selector matches all the headings in a particular section of the classroom catalogue page.
examples.zh: 「CSS 选择器」匹配课堂目录页中某一区域的全部标题。

examples.en: We changed the CSS selector so the new colour applied only to book titles.
examples.zh: 我们更改了「CSS 选择器」，让新颜色仅应用到书名。

words.enDefinition: A property name and value in CSS that specify one aspect of presentation.

examples.en: The CSS declaration sets the font size for the book titles in the sample catalogue.
examples.zh: 这条「CSS 声明」设置了示例目录中书名的字号。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks which CSS declaration changes the background colour of the reading list.
examples.zh: 练习题问的是哪条「CSS 声明」改变阅读书单的背景颜色。

words.enDefinition: A URL that includes its own scheme and can be understood without a base URL.

examples.en: The absolute URL on our worksheet identifies the example timetable regardless of the current page.
examples.zh: 无论当前显示的是哪一页，练习纸上的「绝对 URL」都能标识示例时间表。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to copy the absolute URL including the scheme shown at the start.
examples.zh: 老师让我们把「绝对 URL」抄下来，包括开头的协议名。

words.enDefinition: A URL reference whose meaning is determined using a base URL.

examples.en: The relative URL points to a stylesheet next to the catalogue document in our sample folder.
examples.zh: 「相对 URL」指向示例文件夹里与目录文档放在一起的样式表。

examples.en: We resolved the relative URL against the page address in an exercise done on paper.
examples.zh: 在纸上做练习时，我们根据页面地址解析了「相对 URL」。

words.enDefinition: The portion of a URL that identifies a location or resource within the relevant scheme or host.

examples.en: We changed the URL path in the catalogue exercise to point to the help page.
examples.zh: 在目录练习中，我们修改「URL 路径」让它指向帮助页。

examples.en: The tutor highlighted the URL path before discussing the separate query part that follows it.
examples.zh: 老师先标出「URL 路径」，再讲后面独立的查询部分。

words.enDefinition: a URL component introduced by a hash sign, often referring to a part or state within the identified resource

examples.en: The URL fragment takes readers directly to the opening hours section of the example catalogue page.
examples.zh: 「URL 片段」把读者直接带到示例目录页的开放时间小节。

examples.en: The class used a URL fragment to link to the glossary near the end of the handout.
examples.zh: 全班用一个「URL 片段」链接到网页讲义接近末尾的术语表。

words.enDefinition: An additional resource fetched for use by a document or another main resource.

examples.en: The catalogue's stylesheet is a subresource that the browser loads for use by the page.
examples.zh: 目录样式表是浏览器为页面加载的一个「子资源」。

examples.en: The diagram gives each subresource, including the sample cover image, its own row below the document.
examples.zh: 示意图在文档下方分别为每个「子资源」安排一行，其中包括示例封面图片。

words.enDefinition: The event fired after the HTML document has been parsed and the scripts that delay it have executed.

examples.en: The DOMContentLoaded event fires while the large cover image is still loading in our example.
examples.zh: 示例中，大幅封面图片仍在加载时，「DOMContentLoaded 事件」就已触发。

examples.en: We recorded the DOMContentLoaded event on the timeline after the browser finished parsing the HTML.
examples.zh: 浏览器解析完 HTML 后，我们在时间线上记录了「DOMContentLoaded 事件」。

words.enDefinition: The process by which a browser turns document structure and styles into visible output.

examples.en: The lesson on browser rendering starts with a simple page containing only headings and text.
examples.zh: 这节「浏览器渲染」课从一个只有标题和正文的简单页面入手。

examples.en: The browser rendering diagram follows the catalogue from markup to text and shapes on screen.
examples.zh: 「浏览器渲染」图展示目录从标记变成屏幕上的文字和形状的过程。

words.enDefinition: The step in rendering that determines the sizes and positions of elements on a page.

examples.en: Our diagram places layout calculation before the browser paints the text and boxes on screen.
examples.zh: 示意图把「布局计算」放在浏览器绘制屏幕上的文字和方框之前。

examples.en: The narrower catalogue column changes the results of layout calculation in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，目录栏变窄会改变「布局计算」的结果。

words.enDefinition: The developer tools view that lists network requests and responses made while a web page loads or runs.

examples.en: The network panel lists separate requests for the example catalogue document and its stylesheet.
examples.zh: 「网络面板」分别列出了示例目录文档与其样式表的请求。

examples.en: We opened the network panel to check the status of the classroom page's image request.
examples.zh: 我们打开「网络面板」，查看课堂页面中图片请求的状态。

collocations: inspect a request in the network panel
filter entries in the network panel
